text:
harper: quick concept — compact row layout: left-side project meta, center micro-sparkline (7d), right-side mini-heatmap sparkbar summarizing hourly density. goal: surface spikes while keeping rows dense. question: invoice CTA placement? per-row icon vs header export. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-spark-heat/x

leo: I like compactness. per-row icon helps discovery for frequent downloads but adds visual weight for long lists. maybe show icon for top N projects and hide behind kebab for others. :mag:

sana: propose header "Export" dropdown (primary) + lightweight per-row icon (secondary, hover-visible on desktop, inside accordion on mobile). track clicks on each.

lia: a11y: sparklines must have accessible text fallback e.g., aria-label="Sparkline: 7-day trend — peak on Mar 12, 2026: 42k tokens". heatmap needs non-color cues (pattern) and focusable cells with descriptions. ensure export actions announce start/complete via aria-live.

harper: A/B plan: A = header Export + visible per-row icon for top 8; B = header Export only + per-row in kebab. metrics: time-to-download, #support tickets, export format share. run 2 weeks.

figma-bot: Uploaded: "Compact rows + sparklines" (desktop/mobile). link: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-spark-heat/proto

leo: I'll mock the two variants and mobile accordion by Fri. sana: can you add telemetry hooks for export clicks? lia: I'll schedule NVDA/VoiceOver passes once prototype is up. harper: thanks team — we'll iterate after experiment. :thumbsup:
